clue.text: Language contest extremely tiresome (celebrities involved)

parts.note: to vie is to compete or contest

indicators.note: the celebrities are involved, wrapped up, within the outer letters
the extreme letters of tiresome, its first and last, are taken

parts.note: celebrities are big names

explanation.surface: A competition in some language proves deeply tedious, even with famous faces taking part.
explanation.definitionFit: The national tongue of Vietnam is the language spoken across that Southeast Asian country.

clue.text: Star made donation, having switched sides

indicators.note: the word's left half and right half change places, as if swapping sides

parts.note: to make a donation is to give, past tense gave

explanation.surface: A celebrity gave to charity after changing political party.
explanation.definitionFit: Vega is the bright star in the constellation Lyra.

clue.text: Marathon character's slip crushes watch pursuing record

indicators.note: pursuing means coming after, so this piece follows the record

parts.note: EP is an extended-play record

indicators.note: the slip squeezes the watch inside itself, as if crushing it

parts.note: a slip is an error or moral lapse, a sin
lo is an old word meaning look or watch

explanation.surface: A runner's stumble in a marathon smashes a watch while chasing a record time.
explanation.walkthrough: Marathon is the Greek battle site, so a Marathon character is a letter of the Greek alphabet, not a runner.
explanation.definitionFit: Greek is the language of Marathon, and this is the fifth letter of its alphabet.

clue.text: Nurse props up French architect

indicators.note: in a down answer the piece that props up another sits beneath it, so it comes second

parts.note: Normandy is in France, so Norman can mean French
to foster is to nurse or nurture

explanation.surface: A nurse supports a French architect who needs help.
explanation.definitionFit: The British designer of the Gherkin and Wembley Stadium, Lord Foster, is a famous architect.

clue.text: Mass with current primate

parts.note: M is the abbreviation for mass in physics
and means together with
a rill is a small stream, a current of water

explanation.surface: A church service is held alongside some current religious leader.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mass' and 'primate' suggest a church service and an archbishop; the primate is really a monkey.
explanation.definitionFit: This large West African baboon with a colourful face is a member of the primate order.

clue.text: Bird grounded in hospital connected to islands

indicators.note: the bird is placed in the hospital word

parts.note: san is short for sanatorium, a kind of hospital
the moa was a flightless bird of New Zealand, grounded for good

explanation.surface: A bird that cannot fly is taken to a hospital linked to some islands.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective describes things belonging to Samoa, the Pacific island nation.

clue.text: Man in the street spinning live record

indicators.note: spinning turns the joined words around so they read backwards

parts.note: to be is to live or exist
LP is a long-playing record

explanation.surface: An ordinary passer-by is playing a live album on the turntable.
explanation.definitionFit: An ordinary person, a commoner, is the man in the street.

clue.text: Hair and head fastener

parts.note: a lock is a tress of hair
nut is slang for the head

explanation.surface: Something that fastens hair onto the head.
explanation.definitionFit: A second nut screwed against the first to stop it loosening is a type of fastener.

clue.text: Blunder circulating state dinner's top kitchenware

indicators.note: the blunder goes around the other letters, as if circulating about them

parts.note: bish is British slang for a blunder or mistake
to utter is to state

indicators.note: the top of the word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A gaffe going round the room at a state dinner involves the best kitchenware.
explanation.definitionFit: A covered dish for serving the dairy spread at table counts as kitchenware.

clue.text: Science behind good culinary style

indicators.note: the science comes behind, after, the good letter

parts.note: astronomy is the science of the stars

explanation.surface: Science underpins a good cooking style.
explanation.definitionFit: The art of good eating and the style of cooking of a region are both called this.

clue.text: Maybe lions circling: vamoose!

indicators.note: circling moves the last letter around to the front

parts.note: lions are an example of big cats

explanation.surface: Lions are circling, so get out of here fast!
explanation.definitionFit: Both are slang commands telling someone to go away quickly.

clue.text: 1980s record that's often heard at funerals

definitions.meaning: a David Bowie single released in 1980
the phrase from the burial service, 'earth to earth', spoken at the graveside

explanation.definitionFit: Bowie's 1980 hit took its title from the words of the Christian burial rite.

clue.text: Body part periodically seen in Dublin Bay

indicators.note: periodically means at regular intervals, so every second letter is taken

explanation.surface: Some body part keeps turning up in Dublin Bay.
explanation.definitionFit: This is one of the two long bones of the forearm.

clue.text: Prudence on drive notices small space covered by plant

indicators.note: the plant covers, wraps around, the other letters

parts.note: a rose is a flowering plant
ads are advertisements, notices
an en is a small space in printing, half an em

explanation.surface: A careful motorist sees signs in a tiny gap hidden by shrubbery.
explanation.definitionFit: Awareness of hazards and good judgement in traffic is prudence when driving.

clue.text: Rat hiding affair makes dash

indicators.note: the affair is hidden inside the other word

parts.note: to rat or sing is to inform on someone
a matter is an affair or business

explanation.surface: A rat hiding a love affair makes a run for it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dash' looks like a verb for running off; it is a noun, a small amount.
explanation.definitionFit: A slight amount, a sprinkling, is a dash.

clue.text: Divers left old flipper in embankment westwards

indicators.note: in an across answer going westwards is reading right to left, backwards
the three pieces go in the embankment

parts.note: a dam is an embankment holding back water
a fin is a flipper

explanation.surface: Divers leave an old flipper on an embankment to the west.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Divers' looks like the swimmers who use flippers; it is the old adjective meaning various.
explanation.definitionFit: Both mean many and various, of several kinds.

clue.text: Set of five exercise books lad defaced

parts.note: PE is physical education, exercise
NT is the New Testament, a set of books

indicators.note: defaced means losing the face, the first letter

explanation.surface: A boy has scribbled on five exercise books.
explanation.definitionFit: A group of five things is a pentad, from the Greek for five.

clue.text: Colt perhaps after career that catches wrongdoers

indicators.note: the gun comes after the other word

parts.note: to career is to rush, to speed
a Colt is a make of revolver, a gun

explanation.surface: A young horse chases a career of catching criminals.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Colt' and 'career' suggest a racehorse; they are a revolver maker and a verb for rushing.
explanation.definitionFit: Police use a radar device to catch motorists breaking the limit.

clue.text: Husband wears kitsch clobber

indicators.note: the kitsch wraps the husband as clothes are worn around a body

parts.note: trash is kitsch, tasteless rubbish

explanation.surface: A husband puts on tacky clothes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Clobber' is British slang for clothes, but here it is the verb to hit hard.
explanation.definitionFit: To beat soundly or hit hard is to clobber.

clue.text: Bird table, say, containing bagel

indicators.note: the table holds the bagel within it

parts.note: a roster is a kind of table, a list of duties
a bagel's ring shape looks like the letter O

explanation.surface: A bird table, for instance, has a bagel on it.
explanation.definitionFit: A male domestic fowl is a type of bird.

clue.text: Overhead, swallows move abroad?

parts.note: up means overhead, aloft
to swallow something is to put up with it, as to stick it

explanation.surface: Swallows overhead are migrating to foreign parts.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark signals that moving abroad is only one example of moving home.
explanation.definitionFit: To up sticks is British slang for relocating, packing up and leaving home.

clue.text: Despot shortly commandeering port's passage

indicators.note: the despot seizes the port and holds it inside
shortly means cut short, losing the last letter

parts.note: a czar is an absolute ruler, a despot
Aden is a port in Yemen

explanation.surface: A tyrant briefly seizing a harbour's sea passage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Passage' looks like a sea lane; it is a musical passage.
explanation.definitionFit: A virtuoso solo section near the end of a concerto movement is a musical passage.

clue.text: Spiritual building's song and dance space elevated

indicators.note: in a down answer elevated means raised up, read from bottom to top

parts.note: a song and dance is a fuss, an ado
a gap is a space

explanation.surface: A church's hall for singing and dancing has been raised.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiered Buddhist or Hindu tower is a religious building.

clue.text: Clear river containing sole, seaman recalled

indicators.note: the river holds the other letters inside

parts.note: the Exe is a river in Devon
sole means only, one

indicators.note: recalled means called back, so the word is read in reverse

parts.note: a tar is a sailor

explanation.surface: A sailor has been called back to a river holding fish, to clear him.
explanation.definitionFit: To clear someone of blame is to absolve or exonerate them.

clue.text: Store Diana's outside with limitless cash

indicators.note: limitless means losing the limits, the first and last letters
the outside of the name is its first and last letters

explanation.surface: Diana stays outside a store that has no limit on cash.
explanation.walkthrough: ASDA is a large British supermarket chain.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a British supermarket chain, so it is a store.

clue.text: US racket operator burnt material evidence finally

parts.note: ash is what remains of burnt material

indicators.note: finally means taking the last letter

explanation.surface: A US gangster's burnt evidence is found at last.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Racket operator' suggests a criminal; Arthur Ashe was an American tennis champion who wielded a racket.
explanation.definitionFit: Arthur Ashe was an American tennis star, a wielder of a racket.

clue.text: Aboard boat, oiled revolving bit

indicators.note: revolving turns the letters around to read backwards
aboard means on board, held within the words

explanation.surface: On a boat, someone oils a turning part.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiny amount, a jot, is the Greek letter's sense here.

clue.text: Edward and Tom, say, put on trousers

indicators.note: in an across answer a piece put on another follows it

parts.note: longs are long trousers
Tom Hanks is an example, the American actor

explanation.surface: Edward and Tom are pulling on their trousers.
explanation.walkthrough: Edward I of England was nicknamed for his long legs.
explanation.definitionFit: The nickname of King Edward I, tall with long legs.

clue.text: Taxman once probing work payment

indicators.note: the taxman goes into the work, probing it

parts.note: to go is to work or function
IR is the Inland Revenue, the former British tax authority

explanation.surface: The old tax office is investigating a payment for work.
explanation.walkthrough: A giro is a British bank transfer or a benefit payment.
explanation.definitionFit: A giro is a credit transfer, a cheque or a state benefit payment.

clue.text: Government that sustains part of an Indian city express

parts.note: naan bread is part of an Indian meal, here spelt nan
NY is New York city
to state is to express

explanation.surface: A government supports one district of an Indian city, apparently.
explanation.walkthrough: 'An Indian' is British slang for an Indian restaurant meal, of which nan bread is a part.
explanation.definitionFit: An overprotective government that looks after citizens too much is the one nurturing them.
